dct_description_sm: This theme presents the trophic status of the lakes monitored between 2004 and 2025. Trophic levels are used to classify lakes according to their degree of biological productivity; their condition can vary from ultra-oligotrophic to hyper-eutrophic.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
